'''Paras''' is a [[Finland|Finnish]] QuakeWorld clan founded in [[2009]].

== History ==
The clan Paras was founded in autumn 2009 by Panjabi and Heag. [[EQL Season 10|EQL10]] Division 4 was the first tournament where the clan entered.. and somehow achieved 3rd place.

Paras means ''[http://www.urbandictionary.com/define.php?term=bestest bestest]'' in English.
